title: Thermally Conditioned Time-Series Forecasting of Grain Growth in Polycrystalline Materials
abstract: arXiv:2611.06843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grain growth during heat treatment strongly affects the microstructure of polycrystalline materials and, consequently, their mechanical properties. Although numerical methods such as front-tracking or front-capturing simulations can accurately describe grain growth, their high computational cost limits their use for long or non-isothermal thermal cycles. In previous work, grain growth was successfully predicted under isothermal conditions by treating grain size distributions as time series and forecasting their evolution using recurrent neural networks, allowing complete grain growth trajectories to be generated in seconds rather than through costly PDE-based simulations. In the present work, this forecasting framework is reformulated to handle non-isothermal conditions by explicitly incorporating thermal information into the model architecture. translated_title: 多晶材料晶粒生长的热条件化时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 热处理过程中的晶粒生长会强烈影响多晶材料的微观组织，进而影响其力学性能。尽管前沿跟踪或前沿捕获等数值模拟方法能够准确描述晶粒生长，但其高昂的计算成本限制了其在长时间或非等温热循环中的应用。在以往的工作中，研究者通过将晶粒尺寸分布视为时间序列，并利用循环神经网络预测其演化，成功实现了等温条件下的晶粒生长预测，使得完整的晶粒生长轨迹可以在几秒钟内生成，而无需依赖成本高昂的基于偏微分方程的模拟。在本工作中，该预测框架被重新构建，通过在模型架构中显式引入热信息来处理非等温条件。晶粒尺寸分布使用卷积神经网络进行编码，热描述信息……
tldr: 本研究将热信息显式融入循环神经网络预测框架，把等温条件下的晶粒生长时间序列预测方法扩展到非等温热处理场景，从而能够快速预测变温热循环下晶粒尺寸分布的演化。
en_tdlr: This work reformulates a recurrent-neural-network-based time-series forecasting framework for grain growth by explicitly incorporating thermal information into the model architecture, enabling fast prediction of grain size distribution evolution under non-isothermal heat treatment conditions.
